datasets.name: Sales Revenue Analysis
datasets.description: Monthly sales by customer, product and region for February and March 2026. Revenue falls 20.6%, and one large customer stops ordering.
suggested_questions: Why did revenue fall in March?
Which products drove the revenue decline?
What explains the change in revenue between February and March?

datasets.name: Marketing Campaign Performance
datasets.description: Daily campaign data by channel and campaign type, January to June 2026. Spend and conversions both rise sharply in March.
suggested_questions: Why did spend increase in March?
Which channels drove the change in conversions in March?

datasets.name: Workforce Attrition Analysis
datasets.description: Monthly workforce data by department and seniority, July 2025 to June 2026. Departures nearly triple in April.
suggested_questions: Why did departures increase in April?
Which departments drove the increase in departures in April?

datasets.name: E-Commerce Traffic & Revenue
datasets.description: Weekly traffic and sales by device and traffic source, January to April 2026. Revenue falls 44% in April.
suggested_questions: Why did revenue drop in April?
Which devices drove the drop in sessions in April?
What explains the change in orders between March and April?
